summary: Meta Superintelligence Labs (MSL) launched Muse Image, its first media generation model, along with a preview of Muse Video, with the model described as using reasoning, refinement and tool use plus test-time scaling.

mechanisms.reason: Post claims a new model class (media generation with reasoning and tool use) but gives no benchmark or comparative evidence to support a step-change claim.
mechanisms.quote: Muse image can use reasoning, refinement, and tools to improve precision and quality, with very clear test time scaling trends.

mechanisms.reason: Reference to test-time scaling implies the model spends more compute per generation, but no figures or usage data are given.
mechanisms.quote: with very clear test time scaling trends

practices.reason: A named shipped model (Muse Image) is described as using reasoning, tool use and refinement to improve image generation quality, worth evaluating for multimodal pipelines though no benchmark data is given.
practices.quote: Muse image can use reasoning, refinement, and tools to improve precision and quality
